claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.RetainedOutput
assumptions: Y and Lineage are supplied types.
claims.statement: A retained output pairs its value with explicit lineage data.
claims.ceiling: Typed record only; lineage authenticity and persistence are not established.
claims.residual: The model does not select the source or semantics of lineage.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.LaterSuccessor
assumptions: State and Lineage are supplied types.
claims.statement: A later successor pairs its state with explicit lineage data.
claims.ceiling: Typed record only; no temporal or physical interpretation is supplied.
claims.residual: No account of storage, reachability, or lineage creation.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.FeedbackCertificate
assumptions: Adm and F are supplied; equality is the selected comparison semantics.
claims.statement: A certificate supplies two admitted retained outputs at common input/action, distinct retained records, and unequal later successors.
claims.ceiling: Minimum extensional witness only; it implies no causal reading.
claims.residual: No reachability, intervention, stability, noise, intent, or agency structure.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.AdmittedVariation
assumptions: Adm is the declared admitted-domain predicate; F is a total function; equality is selected.
claims.statement: There exist common input and action and two distinct admitted retained outputs whose successors differ.
claims.ceiling: Extensional dependence on the admitted domain only.
claims.residual: No causal, reachable-influence, intervention, stochastic, or threshold semantics.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.feedback_certificate_iff_admitted_variation
claims.statement: A feedback certificate exists exactly when admitted variation holds.
claims.ceiling: Equivalence of this certificate structure and this extensional predicate.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.y_independence_forbids_feedback_certificate
assumptions: F is independent of the retained-output argument for all compared inputs/actions.
claims.statement: If changing the retained argument never changes the successor, no feedback certificate can exist on any admitted domain.
claims.ceiling: Functional predecessor result; a certificate's admitted witness pair cannot have unequal successors.
claims.residual: Does not classify causal dependence or mechanisms.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.boolRetainedFalse
assumptions: Finite Bool value and Unit lineage fixture.
claims.statement: False retained output in the finite fixture.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.boolRetainedTrue
assumptions: Finite Bool value and Unit lineage fixture.
claims.statement: True retained output in the finite fixture.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.boolEcho
assumptions: Finite Bool state and Unit lineage fixture.
claims.statement: The update copies the retained Bool value and lineage into the later successor.
claims.ceiling: One total finite fixture; copying does not model physical feedback.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.restrictedAdmission
assumptions: The declared admitted domain contains only retained outputs with value false.
claims.statement: A restricted finite domain admits false-valued outputs only.
claims.residual: No claim that a real process has this domain.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.bool_echo_nonconstant_on_full_domain
assumptions: Bool fixture uses both false and true outputs in the ambient type.
claims.statement: The Bool echo update is nonconstant on its full ambient retained-output type.
claims.ceiling: Ambient variation does not establish variation within a chosen admitted domain.
claims.residual: No claim about the reachable image of any process.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.restricted_admitted_domain_has_no_feedback_variation
assumptions: Only false-valued outputs are admitted; lineage is Unit.
claims.statement: Despite ambient nonconstancy, Bool echo has no distinct admitted pair and therefore no admitted feedback variation on this restricted domain.
claims.ceiling: Finite counterexample to replacing admitted-domain dependence with ambient nonconstancy.
claims.residual: Reachability and application-level domain selection remain open.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.allBoolOutputsAdmitted
assumptions: Unit input/action and Bool retained value fixture.
claims.statement: The finite positive fixture admits every retained Bool output.
claims.residual: No connection to a real reachable domain.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.finite_positive_feedback_fixture
assumptions: The finite Bool outputs are admitted and boolEcho copies the retained value.
claims.statement: The two Bool retained outputs give a positive feedback certificate for the finite fixture.
claims.residual: No causal, intervention, stability, or physical conclusion.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Feedback.bool_echo_preserves_lineage
assumptions: The fixture update copies the lineage field by definition.
claims.statement: The finite echo successor retains the lineage value of its input record.
claims.ceiling: Equality in the fixture only; no proof that a real system preserves or authenticates lineage.
claims.residual: Lineage persistence and storage are unmodeled.

manual_dispositions.detail: Causal, intervention, reachable-influence, stability, intent, and agency interpretations are excluded by P0699 and P0703-P0705.
P0701's noise, reachability distinction, and forget-to-A4 consequences are not given stochastic, reachability, or A4-transition models in this bounded fixture.
